apps.name: Ordinero Business
apps.subtitle: Your restaurant tonight
apps.localizedDescription: Tonight’s tables, bills and menu for Ordinero restaurant owners.
apps.versionDescription: Editing an item is now a control panel: the dish as guests see it on top, big tiles for price, sold out, choices and kitchen, and small tiles for labels, dietary, languages, stock, promotion and pairings. Price opens a keypad with quick steps, and sold out saves straight away with Undo. Category, VAT, AR and Delete are in the ⋯ menu.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ordinero uses the camera to scan the sign-in code on your dashboard, to take photos for your menu and to map your room for the table finder.
